programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: More power and yet better fuel economy? This is supposed to be possible with chip tuning. In order to explore this, we sent two teams on a road trip from South Germany to Barcelona, Spain, and back, a total distance of 3,000 kilometres.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: A new car. A new driving experience. A new lifestyle. But what paths do the four wheels, the engine and the car's body need to take until the first drive?

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: The car of the future:aerodynamic, light and quiet, with almost no or no fuel consumption. Is a car like this just a pipe dream of engineers? Or is mobility with alternative drives suitable for the masses?

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: One of the oldest airfields in Germany is located at Oberschleissheim near Munich where exhibits from over 100 years of aviation history were presented to the public. Also, we took a Russian Antonov An-2 biplane for a cruise over the city.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: Precision, high-tech, high quality. After 90 years of eventful history BMW motorbikes are today regarded as being almost too perfect. We explore the company's history between tradition and innovation with all of its ups and downs.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: Rough nature, surreal landscapes, unpredictable weather, but Iceland is also a paradise for lovers of all-wheel vehicles, it's Europe's off-road Mecca.

programme.title: Harley-Davidson Trio
programme.desc: We took a look at three very different Harley-Davidson models. The versatile Switchback Dyna, the motorized wheelie bike Sportster 72, and the bad-boy motorcycle Softail Slim.

programme.title: Ken Block - Gymkhana Grid
programme.desc: Spectacular drifts are to be expected when Ken Block visits the Gymkhana Grid.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The new BMW One M Coupe from former race car driver Ralf Kelleners: the KS1 RS. Also: Toyota present their TS 030 hybrid at the 24-hours race of Le Mans. And: Subaru's XV crossover stands out from the company's model range.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The 'little' Mercedes-Benz S250 with a four-cylinder engine needs so little fuel that one could call this car a piggybank. Also: the power packages Nissan 370 Z and Wiesmann GT MF5. And: the ADAC Eco Test.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The new Porsche Boxter, a real open-top sports car. Also: Volkswagen presents the new Passat Alltrack, a real allrounder. And: Fiat's successful Panda model in its third generation version.

programme.title: Mercedes Sprinter, 2018
programme.desc: The Mercedes Sprinter belongs to the class of commercial vehicles. The light transporter is the dream for every tradesman. The third generation Sprinter is sleeker, more modern and more variable than ever.

programme.title: Arden AJ23
programme.desc: A Jaguar that is able to terrify the world alone with its roar. This Jaguar F-Type R tuned by Arden is a real bad boy. Already in the series production configuration, the F-Type R Coupe is a dream car that can really bite but this Jaguar which has been upgraded from Arden, now calls itself "AJ23“ and is more powerful, louder and more aggressive than any of his brothers.

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Utah, land of red rocks, how it was called by the Native Americans. We are on a motorbike tour driving for 1,500 miles through some of the most beautiful and dramatic landscapes in the US. Part 1

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Utah, land of red rocks, how it was called by the Native Americans. We are on a motorbike tour driving for 1,500 miles through some of the most beautiful and dramatic landscapes in the US. Part 2

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Utah, land of red rocks, how it was called by the Native Americans. We are on a motorbike tour driving for 1,500 miles through some of the most beautiful and dramatic landscapes in the US. Part 3

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Utah, land of red rocks, how it was called by the Native Americans. We are on a motorbike tour driving for 1,500 miles through some of the most beautiful and dramatic landscapes in the US. Part 4

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: In 2011, the European Boss Hoss Rally took place in the Pullman City western town in Germany. We show the highlights of this event where nearly 160 V8 monster bikes were gathered. (Part 1 of 2)

programme.title: KTM 990 Adventure
programme.desc: It's very big and mostly comes in orange: the KTM 990 Adventure. Over rough terrain it's often driven standing up. Today, the 990 is considered the off-road specialist among travel Enduros.

programme.title: Kymco People GT 300i
programme.desc: 10 or 16 inch wheels - is this really just a question of taste? Motorvision reveals the advantages and disadvantages of the big wheel motorcycle People GT 300i, made by Kymco.

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: British limousines are the embodiment of luxury, they are the automotive upper class. Built with the most exclusive materials, these limousines like the Rolls Royce Phantom, Bentley Mulsanne or Jaguar XJ combine luxury, comfort and power.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Whether it is the Mercedes S-Class, the BMW 7-series or the Audi A8, limousines "Made in Germany" are considered status symbols, setting standards when it comes to comfort, pioneering technologies and safety.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: International limousines by Rolls Royce, Bentley, Mercedes, BMW and Jaguar guarantee an exclusive appearance and stand for status, prestige and perfection. They are the benchmark when it comes to luxury and comfort.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Power limousines like the BMW M5, Mercedes-AMG E63, Audi RS6 and Mulsanne Speed offer a unique mix of style, performance and suitability for daily use. They combine the luxury of a limousine with the dynamics of a super sports car.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: They are masterpieces of automotive art, cars of breathtaking elegance, extraordinary performance, built for speeds beyond imagination: Bugatti Chiron, Lykan Hypersports, Pagani Huayra and Ferrari LaFerrari.

programme.title: BMW Kelleners Sport 640i Grand Coupe
programme.desc: The Kelleners Sport 640i is based on one of the most beautiful 4-door coupes. The tuning company of Ralf Kelleners, the son of a three-time European touring car champion, made a name for itself by specializing in remodeling BMWs.

programme.title: Volkswagen Touareg V6 TDI
programme.desc: Volkswagen subjected the Touareg to a radical makeover. After the end of the Phaeton, it's the new luxury top model from VW. Hopes are high: it has to sell big so that management can restore the peoples' confidence in the Volkswagen brand.

programme.title: Ignition GT
programme.desc: Juliet puts the fourth-generation Kia Carens through its paces. We head to Nampo for a unique meeting of Toyota Hiluxes and Zee gets acquainted with a dazzling Range Rover Sport.

programme.title: Buyer's Guide
programme.desc: Comparing hybrid and petrol Corolla ownership costs, evaluating repaired Mercedes-Benz C200 buying risks, and asking if EV ownership is practical without home charging for buyers.

programme.title: Garage Gold
programme.desc: We kick off the season with sending to George to the Old Car Show. And we kick off our Garage Gold Concourse competition with a Morgan Roadster and a Jaguar XK120.

programme.title: Petrolheads
programme.desc: We see some insane spinning action, are in search of the ultimate burnout king at the south coast and meet the crew behind the solar-powered Beetle.

programme.title: Riding with Ken Block in the Ford F-150 RaptorTRAX
programme.desc: He has chased some of the most savage cars over all continents, but for his latest adventure, Ken Block heads to the mountains to pilot a Ford Raptor with a 6.2-litre supercharger and snowTRAX.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Hybrid cars with lots of power. The McLaren Artura combines revolutionary hybrid technology with racing DNA. Ferrari also counts on the combined power of electricity and petrol in the 296 GTB. Also: Mercedes S 580e and Cupra Leon Sportstourer.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: What is crucial in a sports car? Performance? Precision? Or the unrivalled feeling of dominating the road - such as in the McLaren 600 LT, the Aston Martin Vantage or the Alfa Romeo Giulia GTAm?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Power sports station wagons are family cars with sports car DNA. The Audi RS6 has evolved over decades from an inconspicuous family car to a technological masterpiece. But the competition is not to be underestimated.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: On the road or offroad – this car is supposed to master all driving situations. The Porsche 911 Dakar is one of the most extreme series 911 models of all times. We tested this extraordinary 911 on rough terrain and explain how this special concept came to life.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: From racing legends to sporty luxury road cruisers: No one bridges the gap between driving pleasure and comfort as well as BMW. We put the racetrack icon M4 CSL to the test. And: Is the BMW M760e more of a driver's or a chauffeur's car?

programme.title: Volkswagen Golf GTI and Golf R
programme.desc: The 7th Generation of the Volkswagen Golf GTI and R is made to give people affordable driving fun.

programme.title: Aston Martin DB4 GT Zagato
programme.desc: In 1960 the British sports car manufacturer wanted to give the DB4 GT a new look and hired Italian designer Zagato. Today, this Aston Martin is one of the best and most beautiful sports car of all time.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Being one step ahead of time has always been a bit pricier. But is the new BMW i8 just an luxurious, avant-garde carrier of technology or can it already be considered as a serious sports car? Why should you pay double the price compared to the BMW M4? Why shouldn’t you buy a good looking BMW M5, which has the same price, but is more functional? Supercars reveals the answers.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche 911 GTS is the latest model in the iconic 911 sports car range. With an output of 430 HP it closes the gap between the S model and the GT3. Supercars gets the chance to take a ride in the new Porsche 911 GTS in California. Plus: The Roding Roadster is a small series lightweight sports car from Bavaria and uses technology from BMW under its bonnet.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: These days there's hardly a car manufacturer who doesn¿t build any kind of SUV. Three of the sportiest SUVs on the market are the Porsche Macan Turbo, Mercedes GLA 45 AMG and Audi RSQ3. Each of them comes with more than 300 HP; they are well prepared for any season and have ambitions to be sports car. Supercars finds out, if they have what it takes to be a sports car.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche Panamera Turbo S is the most dynamic sedan in the world. No other car finds the perfect balance between calm gliding on the one hand and extreme performance on the other hand. 570 hp, 3,8 seconds from zero to 100 km/h and a top speed of 310 km/h are impressive performance data for this big car. Plus: the Jaguar XJR with a 550 hp V8 engine and the Mercedes CLS 500.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Luxury does not necesseraly mean to waste time. Hybrid is one of the techniques wich promises less fuel consumption with a still powerful engine. Lexus ist the pioneer in electrification of cars. Supercars drives the new LS 600h, The BMW Actiev Hybrid 7 and teh Porsche Panamera S E-Hybrid.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Silvretta Hochalpenstrasse in Austria is the ideal playground for the lightweight power packs Lotus Elise and Roding Roadster. These two roadsters are glued to the street and therefore a lot of fun to drive. And: the elegant but still very powerful Porsche 911 Targa 4S.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: If people hear the name Aston Martin they imagine James Bond adventures, British style, performance and luxury. The brand's Vantage N430 model is a sports car that makes drivers and enthusiasts feel the heritage of British race cars. Also: a combination of elegance and power, the Bentley Continental GTC Speed with its W12 Twin Turbo engine.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: In 2014, Mercedes-Benz presented their first Plug-in Hybrid, the S500. With a declared average consumption of 2.8 liters the S500 was the most fuel-efficient luxury car on the market. Also: when it comes to Bentley, a V8 engine basically means down-sizing. We took a look at the British brand's Flying Spur version with a smaller engine. And: the 6th generation Maserati Quattroporte.

programme.title: Volkswagen Touareg V6 TDI
programme.desc: Volkswagen subjected the Touareg to a radical makeover. After the end of the Phaeton, it's the new luxury top model from VW. Hopes are high: it has to sell big so that management can restore the peoples' confidence in the Volkswagen brand.

programme.title: Jeep Wrangler
programme.desc: In 2018 the fourth generation of the Wrangler was introduced. I contained state-of-the-art technology, but the rugged look remained the same. The brand works hard to maintain this silhouette since the very first Jeep ever, the Willys MB.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: An angry bull, a few Englishmen who prepared themselves for rather unpleasant weather conditions and a young, talented race driver, these were all visitors who ventured to the infamous Green Hell of the Nürburgring.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: A tuned-up Golf 2, a family sedan from Hanover, Germany and a very special Porsche GT2. We looked behind the scenes of the gas station by the curve on the race track where sports cars flock.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: When the Nürburgring transforms into a winter wonderland, it may look pleasant but sure isn't too pleasant as a race track.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Fog, rain and snow means that a visit to the Eifel region isn't too pleasant. Nevertheless, the toughest drivers were at the track, not letting the weather get in their way.

programme.title: Jaguar XJR
programme.desc: The highlight of the XJR lies beneath the hood: all of Jaguar's top models are equipped with the 5-liter V8 compressor engine that delivers 550 HP in this sports sedan.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Nowadays the gull-winged classic DeLorean is an automotive investment. Also: 100 dream cars under the hammer at a classic car auction in Switzerland. And: modern classics with investment potential like the Mercedes 190E 2.3 16V.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The BMW 328 'Schlüter' wrote racing history in the 1930s. Today, the unique car is operational again. Also: the TVR 3000M Cosworth is able to scare any Porsche out of its mind. And: a 60 years old Opel Kapitän gets a makeover.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: At the latest since a 1967 Toyota 2000 GT was sold at auction in the USA for 1.2 million dollars, Japanese classic cars have a different status. We present old and youngtimers "Made in Japan".

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6
programme.desc: More extremes are always possible. Volvo's Laplander army vehicle has 6 wheels, 3 axles and provides space for at least 12 soldiers.

programme.title: Harley-Davidson Trio
programme.desc: We took a look at three very different Harley-Davidson models. The versatile Switchback Dyna, the motorized wheelie bike Sportster 72, and the bad-boy motorcycle Softail Slim.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: In this episode we followed W Motors when they presented their 3.4 million dollar prototype of the Lykan HyperSport at the Dubai Motor Show, where the twin turbo flat six 770 hp engine came alive in the fully assembled super sports car for the first time. Then, the Lykan underwent its first high speed test drive at the Dubai Motodrome.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Driving the Porsche Cayman GTS is like riding a bullet, it's a constant thrill, but in a controllable surrounding. On the sunny island of Mallorca we made this fun machine climb hills and take on a race track. In addition: the state-of-the-art Corvette C7 in a Wild West theme park. And: the Nissan 370 Z Nismo, an affordable sportscar from the manufacturer's house tuner with an individual style.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: If you're a passionate sports car fan and a family person at the same time, don't worry, as there are ways to combine both of these passions. The E 63 S AMG T with its V8 biturbo engine is as fast as a sportscar can be and takes you and your family wherever you want. In addition: the Audi RS6. And: the G-Power Hurrican with 750 hp.

programme.title: Alpina B6
programme.desc: An Alpina is optically never intrusive. Understatement is the motto. One should not recognize at first glance, what potential is hidden under the bodywork. Huge spoilers are not used and neither are striking power domes. Any modifications serve the technical improvement, for example, optimized cooling and aerodynamics.

programme.title: Lexus LS600h
programme.desc: Lexus is a pioneer in the construction of modern hybrid vehicles. In 2007 the Toyota brand's premium marque introduced the LS 600h with a combination of electric and combustion drive.

programme.title: PINKS 2.0 - S1E1
programme.desc: It’s been 20 years in the making — the return of the drag racing reality TV show that started it all. New host Bruno Massel. New network. Built by automotive enthusiasts, for automotive enthusiasts. In Episode 1, we take you along for the full journey — from the origins of PINKS racing to today’s PINKS 2.0 competition at Rockingham Dragway. You’ll meet the racers who put it all on the line and step into the legendary PINKS Circle. The road wasn’t easy. Breakdowns, setbacks, and hurdles stood in the way, and every racer had to fight just to make it to the track and earn their shot to compete. Sit back and enjoy the ride as we bring you PINKS 2.0.

programme.title: COLLISION 9
programme.desc: GLORY heavyweight world champion Mory Kromah (37-3-1, 21 KO) defends his title against Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (19-5, 10 KO), Croatian superstar Antonio Plazibat (23-5, 16 KO) faces Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (49-5, 37 KO) and the GLORY light heavyweight grand prix plays out in full, deciding the next GLORY light heavyweight world champion.

programme.title: GLORY 109: Welterweight GP
programme.desc: GLORY double champ Chico Kwasi (46-6-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world championship in the main event in a trilogy fight against top Bulgarian Teodor Hristov (20-5, 8 KO). A gigantic heavyweight clash takes place as former interim heavyweight champion Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (31-5-1, 17 KO) collides with the legend Errol ‘The Bonecrusher’ Zimmerman (112-21-1, 45 KO). Also happening at GLORY 109 are the Welterweight Proving Grounds. Several match-ups will take place where fighters aim to impress in order to put their names forward for the GLORY welterweight eight-man grand prix at the end of the year.

programme.title: GLORY 36 SuperFight Series
programme.desc: GLORY 36 SuperFight Series is headlined by Congolese-German light heavyweight Danyo Ilunga throwing down with the Netherlands' Michael Duut. Armenian-Belgian power puncher Harut Grigorian battles 23-year-old German prospect Danijel Solaja at welterweight in the can't miss co-headline bout. Plus two Super Bantamweight Grand Prix bouts. Muay Thai champion and MMA star Tiffany van Soest meets Canadian challenger Jessica Gladstone in one semifinal match-up, while 21-year-old Dutch prospect Isis Verbeek takes on undefeated Amel Dehby of France. The winners of each semifinal match-up will advance to the Grand Prix tournament final – the opening bout of GLORY: COLLISION.

programme.title: GLORY 36 Oberhausen
programme.desc: The Lightweight title is on the line as Sittichai looks to defend his title against #1 challenger Marat Grigorian. There is also a four-man lightweight tournament on the card.

programme.desc: It's the fight everyone wants to see as GLORY Heavyweight champion, Rico Verhoeven takes on Badr Hari. Plus, the Welterweight title is on the line as Nieky Holzken meets Cedric Doumbé.

programme.desc: Brazilian GLORY middleweight champion Alex ‘Po Atan’ Pereira (31-6, 20 KO’s) headlines the GLORY 74 ARNHEM section of the card, putting his title on the line against Ertugul Bayrak (18-6, 5 KO’s) in a main event fight set for five rounds.

programme.title: UFA 435 - Clan Wars 51 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 51 part 3 from Belfast, Ireland. In the featherweight division Nikola Ivanovic faces Damien McKenna in an MMA matchup and Fynn O'Neill takes on Padraig Irvine in the Catchweight fight. Ash Williams and Ciaran Mullholand take to the cage while Kian McCarton takes on Billy Sutherland for the Flyweight title. In the main event Lethal Shea Leathem challenges Jamie the Spider Monkey McCaugherty in a Welterweight championship title fight.

programme.title: UFA 470 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 16 part 1 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. Starting off this episode is Gebril Chaibi versus Miguel Guzman in a flyweight bout followed by a light heavyweight matchup as Blair Sannoh and Emmanueli Adzoh step into the cage. In the main event, Anthony "The Bully" Romero takes on Ricardo Diaz, the Brazillian veteran, for the vacant UNF Bantamweight title.

programme.title: UFA 474 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 16 part 2 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. In ther first bout, Angel Becerra steps into the cage with undefeated Carson Dohan. In the lightweight division, veteran Darion Champman looks to stop Diego Perez' three bout winning streak. Up next grappler Joe Murphy returns to the cage for a match against boxer Luciano Ramos in a catchweight bout.

programme.title: UFA 479 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 16 part 3 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. Young prospect Joseph Rodriguez looks to keep his undefeated record intact against Jesse Langarica making his pro debut in a catchweight bout. In the main event, it's a battle for the UNF featherweight title, as UFC veteran Francisco Rivera takes on UFC hopeful Jesse Strader.

programme.title: UFA 497 - UFA’s Baddest Babes – Best of part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Best of Baddest Babes part 1 with an action-packed episode featuring all female fighters showcasing the skill, strength and personalities of women redefining the world of combat sports. Bouts include SFT: Bianca Sattelmayer versus Florencia Greco, TuffNUff: Roma Pawelek versus Aspen Ladd, NAAFS: Tecia Torres versus Rebecca Gruitza, SFT: Julia Polastri versus Jessica Cunha, BTC: Lindsay Garbatt versus Rayanne Dos Santos and SFC: Lainey Nations versus Stormie Kilgore

programme.title: UFA 368 - BKB 35 - Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 35 part 1 from London. This episode starts off with a female match between Romanian Maria Nitescu and Stockholm's Mathilda Wilson, Aaron Sinclair takes on Sultan Ahmed and Tony Barratt steps into the ring with Andrei Nastac making his BKB debut. Also in this episode Corey Healey and Hayden Sherriff are set to meet the challenge while Paul Hilz and Nathan Massey face off in five rounds of BKB.

programme.title: UFA 369 - BKB 35 - Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 35 part 2 from London. In this episode of UFA Jack McLean and Dan Gittens both out of London take to the ring, Benji Robinson meets Gavin Curragh in the ring and Liam Wilson, making his BKB debut, faces Tony Shields. In the co-main event for the World cruiserweight title, CJ Mills and Carl Hobley battle for the belt and in the main event defending champion Jimmy Sweeney (27-4) faces challenger Marley Churcher in a contest for the World Welterweight Title.

programme.title: UFA 428 - Clan Wars 51 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 51 part 1 from Belfast, Ireland. Aussie bowlers take the honours on opening day | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | First Test, Day 1
programme.desc: Mitchell Starc set the tone with a wicket off the game's second ball, Nathan Lyon created plenty of chances before removing Cheteshwar Pujara, and Virat Kohli was run out to spark a mini-collapse against the new pink ball on an entertaining first day

programme.title: India take upper hand in enthralling day-night Test | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | First Test, Day 2
programme.desc: A wicket just before stumps gave Australia a late boost after India took a handy first-innings lead on day two of the first Vodafone Test in Adelaide

programme.title: Adelaide amazes again | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | First Test, Day 3
programme.desc: Australia started day three looking to limit India's first innings lead, they ended it with an eight-wicket win in under two sessions of play after one of the more remarkable days of Test cricket

programme.title: India’s bowlers fire on entertaining Boxing Day | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | Second Test, Day 1
programme.desc: Eleven wickets fell on the opening day of the second Vodafone Test as India responded to their defeat in Adelaide by rattling Australia’s batters

programme.title: Rahane's unbeaten ton puts India on top | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | Second Test, Day 2
programme.desc: Stand-in India captain Ajinkya Rahane has filled Virat Kohli's imposing shoes in impeccable style with his 12th Test century lifting the tourists to an 82-run first-innings lead over Australia in the second Test

programme.title: Superb India take control after Aussie batting disaster | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | Second Test, Day 3
programme.desc: After being bowled out for 326, India ran through Australia's batting order to the tune of 6-133 on an eventful day three of the second Vodafone Test

programme.title: India level series at MCG with convincing eight-wicket win | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | Second Test, Day 4
programme.desc: Australia rookie Cameron Green put up a fight with a well-made 45 but the home side could only manage a 69-run lead, which India rattled off with minimal fuss despite the early loss of two wickets

programme.title: Labuschagne, Pucovski fifties boost Aussies amid the rain | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | Third Test, Day 1
programme.desc: Test debutant Will Pucovski hit an assured and composed 62 in his maiden knock while Marnus Labuschagne finished unbeaten on 67 as the pair dominated the first day where only 55 overs were possible amid traditional Sydney rain

programme.title: Late wickets boost Australia after Smith hundred | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | Third Test, Day 2
programme.desc: India's bowlers fought back impressively on day two of the third Test before two late wickets brought Australia back into the match

programme.title: Bowling, fielding gives Australia edge | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | Third Test, Day 3
programme.desc: Three run outs and another excellent Australian bowling performance has handed Australia the upper hand over India after three days of the third Test

programme.title: Aussies grab late wickets after Green, Smith fire | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | Third Test, Day 4
programme.desc: Cameron Green posted his highest Test score and Steve Smith impressed again before Australia removed both openers as India look to stave off defeat in the third Test

programme.title: Brave India pull off the great escape at the SCG | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | Third Test, Day 5
programme.desc: A hobbled Hanuma Vihari and a battered Ravichandran Ashwin defy Australia's bowlers for the entire final session after Rishabh Pant and Cheteshwar Pujara laid the platform for a famous drawn Test

programme.title: Honours split on day one at the Gabba | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | Fourth Test, Day 1
programme.desc: Marnus Labuschagne's century was the highlight for the hosts, while India's rookie bowling attack took up the fight to Australia on day one of the fourth Test in Brisbane

programme.title: Cummins and Lyon strike for Aussies before storm arrives | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | Fourth Test, Day 2
programme.desc: India reached 2-62 at the Gabba before the rain arrived, frustrating Australia's hunt for wickets on day two

programme.title: India lower order frustrates Aussies with Test evenly poised | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | Fourth Test, Day 3
programme.desc: A 123-run partnership between Washington Sundar and Shardul Thakur saw India bowled out just 33 runs short of Australia's first innings, with Josh Hazlewood claiming a five-wicket haul, before Australia's openers extended their lead to 54 by stumps

programme.title: Siraj five, Smith runs help set stage for grand finale | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | Fourth Test, Day 4
programme.desc: Australia entered day four looking to press on to build a big lead, but five wickets to Mohammed Siraj and four for Shardul Thakur pegged the home side back, with Steve Smith the only player passing 50, setting up an epic day five finish.

programme.title: India claim stunning series win | RAPID REWIND | 2020/21 Border-Gavaskar Trophy | Fourth Test, Day 5
programme.desc: Rishabh Pant was the hero as an injury-ravaged India ended Australia's 32-year undefeated run at the Gabba, executing a record-breaking final day chase to win the Test by three wickets and the series 2-1

programme.title: Semifinals - Virginia vs. Florida
programme.desc: Witness a clash of collegiate giants as the University of Virginia and the University of Florida battle for a spot in the finals at Performance Pickleball RVA. The intensity is at an all-time high after Florida's grueling "dream breaker" victory over NC State to reach this stage. Elite talent takes center stage, featuring former D1 tennis stars like Laura Font and Norwegian standout Martinez Sunstein facing off against Virginia’s deep roster of defending champions. From powerful serves to tactical kitchen play, every point counts in this high-stakes quest for a championship bid.

programme.title: WPBL 2026 - Bengaluru vs Rajasthan - Day 9 Tie 1
programme.desc: Experience the high-octane energy of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) Season 2 as the Bengaluru Jawans go head-to-head with the Rajasthan Titans at the iconic Jio World Garden in Mumbai. The stakes are higher than ever in this Day 9, Tie 16 clash, featuring elite matchups such as the "women's singles player of the season" Katrina Stewart facing off against the resilient Lorena Dupnik. Watch as tactical masters like Dusty Boyer and Jack Foster battle for supremacy in a series of intense singles and mixed doubles competitions where every point counts toward the league standings. With game-changing "Pickle Plays" and atmospheric "drums" fueling the intensity, this tie is a masterclass in professional grit and strategic precision.

programme.desc: The World Pickleball League (WPBL) action heats up on Day 4 with a crucial clash between the Hyderabad Superstars and Mumbai Pickle Power at the CCI Brabourne Stadium. programme.title: English Open 2023 – Women’s Doubles 4.5+ Final – Fudge & Barr vs Whitwell & Bohnert
programme.desc: Experience the exciting Women's Doubles Open 4.5+ Final from the 2023 English Open held at Bolton Arena, Greater Manchester. This match features dynamic teams: Megan Fudge and Susannah Barr face off against Lee Whitwell and Riley Bohnert in a highly competitive final. Follow expert commentary highlighting key plays including Susannah Barr’s precise lobs, Megan Fudge’s powerful forehand, and strategic teamwork. See how the match unfolds in a best-of-three games format with a hard stop on time. This showcase of top-level English pickleball captures the skill, tactics, and intensity of the sport. Stay tuned for post-match insights and upcoming mixed doubles action.

programme.title: Picklebowl 2022 – Men’s Doubles – Granot & Siler vs Phillips & Sherry
programme.desc: Watch as Pickleball Pros Dan Granot and Phillip Phillips, paired with NFL legend Brandon Siler and Pickleball professional Ryan Sherry, battle it out in this thrilling Men's Doubles match from the Picklebowl 2022. Filmed in the stunning Sea Island, Georgia, this unique event brings together celebrities and professional athletes representing their alma maters. The game is not only about competition but also raising funds for a great cause, benefiting Desire Street Ministries. With star power from both the sports and entertainment worlds, this exciting match is filled with hard-hitting shots, strategic play, and thrilling moments that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

programme.title: NCPA 2026 - University of Wisconsin vs. University of California San Diego
programme.desc: The atmosphere at the Arch Pickleball Center is electric as the Wisconsin Badgers face off against the UCSD Tritons on Championship Sunday. The match features a high-speed Racing intensity as both teams fight to stay alive in the single-elimination bracket. Fans will see the refined Skills of Kina Chang and the tactical precision of Lisa Ritchie as they trade "laser beam" drives and calculated dinks at the kitchen line. With Freestyle shot-making on full display—from around-the-post (ATP) winners to highlight-reel volleys—this quarterfinal clash proves that the best collegiate pickleball in the nation was truly saved for Sunday.

programme.title: US Open 2025 - Women's Pro Singles - Jardim vs. Kop
programme.desc: Get ready for a great singles match as Simone Jardim takes on Kristen Kopp at the Usopp National Pickleball Center. This venue, home to the Usopp Pickleball Academy, is a hub for lessons and training, making it an amazing facility for all things pickleball.

programme.title: October 24, 2023 - AZ PBL
programme.desc: October 24, 2023 - Welcome to week 5 - season 2 of The Arizona Pickleball League! It's Tuesday Night Pickleball @ The Orchard, and the Gilbert Gladiators face-off against the Peoria Pythons.

programme.title: US Open 2025 - Women's Sr. Pro Doubles - Courter/Carter vs. Dawson/Williams
programme.desc: This championship game highlights the strategic play, including lobs and speed-ups, as both teams battle for the gold. A key dynamic of this match is that Courter and Carter had the advantage of playing under the shaded court conditions just before, while Dawson and Williams were coming from outside. Jen Dawson is noted as being a seasoned player on this court, having a triple crown in the Senior Pro divisions.

programme.title: US Open 2025 - Mixed Split Pro Age - Oncins/Jardim vs. Miscik/Domoracki
programme.desc: Get ready for an exciting Mixed Split Pro Age pickleball match featuring the formidable team of Jaime Oncins and Simone Jardim against the new pairing of Ryan Miscik and Christie Domoracki. Oncins is a former professional tennis player from Brazil. His partner, Simone Jardim, is a professional pickleball player, a Pickleball Hall of Fame inductee, and was once ranked the number one female player in the world. They face a new team with Ryan Miscik, a pro pickleball player and coach based in Venice, Florida. His partner, Christie Domoracki, is a player located in Boca Grande, Florida. This match brings together a mix of experienced pros and up-and-coming talent for a high-stakes competition on Florida's Paradise Coast.

programme.title: Ohio State University vs. University of Florida
programme.desc: The atmosphere reaches a fever pitch as the Ohio State Buckeyes and Florida Gators face off in a high-stakes battle for the 2023 DUPR Collegiate National Championship. Referee Kate Johnson sets the tone early, enforcing strict regulations on net contact and service line precision to ensure every point is earned through pure grit. Spectators will witness an intense racing flow as players scramble for kitchen control, showcasing the technical skills required to navigate high-speed volleys and strategic double bounces. With Florida utilizing critical timeouts to regroup against Ohio State’s relentless pressure, the match transforms into a display of freestyle athleticism and raw competitive spirit. Don’t miss a second of the action as these elite collegiate athletes fight to keep their championship dreams alive.

programme.title: WPBL 2025 - Bengaluru vs. Delhi - Day 5 Tie 1
programme.desc: It's a "Terrific Tuesday" at the World Pickleball League (WPL) as Day 5 features a critical matchup between the Bengaluru Jawans and the Delhi Dilwale. The stakes are high: Delhi, currently number five on the points table, has a chance to move to number three if the results go their way, while Bengaluru looks to bounce back from a recent loss.

programme.title: US Open 2023 – Women’s Senior Pro Doubles Quarterfinal – Wilhelm & Shirley vs LeBlang & Tarn
programme.desc: In this gripping quarterfinal from the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships, Helen Wilhelm and Anna Shirley face Suzanne LeBlang and Teresa Tarn in a thrilling three-game battle. Featuring powerful strokes, smart resets, and tactical momentum shifts, this senior pro women’s doubles match highlights both experience and finesse. Watch as the teams adapt and clash in a showcase of skill and strategy at the highest level.

programme.title: 2026 Pickleball US Open – Saturday Match 2 - Waters/Devilliers vs. Sewing/Diamond
programme.desc: Saturday Match 2 from the 2026 Franklin US Open Pickleball Championships features Anna Leigh Waters and Jay Devilliers taking on Sofia Sewing and Casey Diamond in an exciting mixed doubles showdown. Watch high-level pickleball action with fast-paced rallies, strategic shot-making, and elite competition from some of the tournament’s top players.

programme.title: Arizona Pickleball League 2023 – Week 4 – Trefry & Mercado vs Lloyd & Montoya
programme.desc: In Week 4 of Season 2, the Arizona Pickleball League brings another exciting Tuesday night match at The Orchard. This week, the Peoria Pythons take on the Surprise Stingers, with thrilling moments and intense competition. Featuring standout players like Ryan Trefry, Lauren Mercado, Michael Lloyd, and Nico Montoya, the teams face off in a high-energy battle. From dynamic mixed doubles to powerful gender doubles, every set and game keeps viewers at the edge of their seats. Will the Pythons maintain their momentum, or will the Stingers make a dramatic comeback? Don’t miss this action-packed match full of strategy, drama, and plenty of pickleball!

programme.title: North Carolina vs. Virginia
programme.desc: The stage is set at the Collegiate National Championships for a high-stakes final showdown between the defending champions, the University of North Carolina Tar Heels, and the powerhouse University of Virginia Cavaliers. In an electric atmosphere fueled by a raucous Virginia crowd, the "third man" in the stands, both teams battle for the ultimate prize: the national championship trophy. Watch as top-tier athletes like former soccer player Caitlin Lewis and lefty specialist Lorelai lead their teams through a technical "reset clinic," showcasing elite defensive rallies that would impress the pros. With Sarah Carpenter adding her multi-sport prowess to the mix, this four-game match delivers high-velocity firefights, strategic timeouts, and momentum shifts that define the pinnacle of collegiate pickleball.

programme.title: NCPA Indiana Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - Purdue vs. Creighton
programme.desc: Live from the NCPA Indiana Regional 2025, watch a thrilling collegiate pickleball battle between Purdue University and Creighton University. Tied at 2-2 entering the broadcast, this match features intense mixed doubles action that decides the series.Key matchups include Purdue’s Emma Jones and Jay Barath facing off against Creighton’s Russell Lee and Lucy. Later, Purdue’s Caleb Young and Tammy Lamb take on Creighton’s Noah Wodzinski and Elizabeth Cook.

programme.title: GNV Chomp vs O Town Bangers
programme.desc: GNV Chomp vs O Town Bangers in the Florida Pro League, stop 3. New players for both teams, including Christine Marseco and Savannah from Punta Gorda Tide.

programme.title: NCPA 2026 Semifinal - Utah Tech vs. Florida Atlantic University
programme.desc: The atmosphere at the Arch Pickleball Center in Saint Louis reaches a fever pitch as the Utah Tech Trailblazers face off against the FAU Owls in a high-stakes semifinal showdown. This match showcases a "racing" intensity as Liam Duffin looks to maintain Utah Tech's momentum following their grueling victory over Colorado. Fans are treated to the technical "skills" and "freestyle" shot-making of Alex LaMacchia, whose crafty drop shots and highlight-reel volleys keep the score neck and neck throughout the opening game. With a spot in the National Championship on the line, both squads must navigate high-pressure video challenges and tactical timeouts in a match many spectators believe is worthy of the final itself.

programme.title: US Open 2025 - Pro Men's Doubles - Livornese/Deheart vs. Lane/Newell
programme.desc: Get ready for thrilling Pro Men's Doubles pickleball action from the Minto US Open Pickleball Championships at East Naples Community Park, the National Pickleball Center! This semi-final match features the dynamic duo of Richard Livornese Jr. and Ryler Deheart against the formidable team of Ben Newell and Brandon Lane. Witness incredible rallies, aggressive plays, and strategic dinks as these top players battle it out for a spot in Championship Saturday. Don't miss this high-energy competition from the epicenter of pickleball!

programme.title: US Open 2025 - Pro Women's Doubles - Waters/Waters vs. Rosati/Campbell
programme.desc: In this US Open 2025 Pro Women's Doubles match, the Waters duo (Anna Lee Waters and Lee Waters) take on Amanda Rosati and Kaitlyn Campbell. The commentators highlight the Waters' dominant performance, particularly Anna Lee's disguised shots and aggressive play, as they secure a swift victory. They also discuss the challenges of the progressive draw format in pickleball and preview Anna Lee Waters' upcoming mixed doubles match with Andre Agassi.

programme.title: NCPA 2026 - Purdue Boilermakers vs. Liberty Flames
programme.desc: The atmosphere at the Arch Pickleball Center reaches a fever pitch as the #8 seed Purdue Boilermakers and #9 seed Liberty Flames collide in a Round of 16 battle with a $1,000 bounty on the line. The Racing intensity of the match is underscored by "nasty rips" and rapid-fire exchanges that leave no room for error. Technical Skills are on full display as players execute precision "Ernie" maneuvers and high-level dinking strategies at the kitchen line. In a Freestyle display of collegiate grit, both programs fight through momentum shifts and "money bag" pressures to prove they belong among the nation's elite.

programme.title: NCPA Virginia Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - UVA vs. High Point
programme.desc: Live from Virginia Beach at the NCPA Virginia Regional 2025, the University of Virginia (UVA) faces off against High Point University in a crucial pool play match. With a bid to the National Championship in St. Louis on the line, these teams battle through a best-of-seven format.The episode kicks off with Women's Singles featuring Alexandra McDonald (UVA) and Sushi Bandaru (High Point), followed by an intense Men's Singles showdown between Eric Lee (UVA) and High Point's wild card, Freddy Ortmann. The action heats up in Men's Doubles with Cooper Duncan joining Ortmann, and Aiden Eggleston partnering with Lee. programme.title: NCPA 2026 - Perseus vs. Hyperion Nationals
programme.desc: Experience the electrifying atmosphere of the Joola Showcase at the NCPA Nationals, where the top 12 collegiate athletes in America converge for a high-octane battle between Team Hyperion and Team Perseus. The match features a Racing pace with a unique sudden-death format that forces players to switch between singles, doubles, and mixed rounds every three points. Watch as these elite competitors demonstrate incredible Skills at the kitchen line, including precision dinks and aggressive "off the bounce" initiates that define modern collegiate play. In a Freestyle display of athleticism, stars like Jaden Broderick and Alexandra McDonald trade "exhibition-style" points in a quest to secure premium Yola paddles for their victory. programme.title: Left Index Presents: Scratch Miscellaneous
programme.desc: This is the very first surf film by Ryan Thomas. One-part road odyssey, one-part art flick, one-part classic surf adventure. Shot entirely on beautiful super-8mm.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Psychic Migrations - Isla De Algas
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of ‘Psychic Migrations’, director Ryan Thomas revives a trip that didn’t make it into the original film. In this edit from the cutting room floor, ISLA DE ALGAS, Ryan Burch and Andrew Doheny brave the sea, walk a deserted island, and rip the walls of a cold right hander.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Tweakin' On Boards With Ryan Burch
programme.desc: Tweakin’ on Boards was shot in 2009. Seems like a second ago and forever ago. Truth is it’s both. As a surfer and filmmaker, Burch isn’t content complaining everything's already been done. Says fellow surfer Cyrus Sutton, “He needs to FEEL history for himself.” This film is that and more.

programme.title: Arc’teryx Presents: Happy Recluse
programme.desc: For many years Pete Devries and Jeremy Koreski have been on a mission to surf the best waves Vancouver Island has to offer. In particular, they return again and over to a wave with potential for a legendary session. In the process, Pete tells of his life as a ”Happy Recluse," at home in cold water.

programme.title: Roxy Presents: New Colors
programme.desc: Faced with the winter waters of Norway, four female professional surfers step out of their comfort zone, push their boundaries and redefine their approach to surfing. Beyond competition sites, they reconnect with the pleasure of sharing their passion through a unique cold water experience.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Lobotomy
programme.desc: Set to the music of Frankie and the Witch Fingers, LOBOTOMY offers nonstop surf action. This relentless cinematic climax will leave surf fanatics in a puddle of drool. File under instant classic. Featuring Yago Dora, Jack Robinson, Noa Deane, Ozzie Wright, Balaram Stack and Ryan Burch.

programme.title: Nazaré
programme.desc: Nazaré is a giant wave in Portugal. This footage was captured October 29, 2020, during one of the biggest swells in history. On this day, the German surfer, Sebastian Steudtner, rode a 26-meter wave. This event set new Guinness World Records and established Nazaré as a global surf destination.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: XO - Coco Ho
programme.desc: Step into the world of pro surfer Coco Ho. Raised on Oahu’s North Shore, the film explores how Ho got started in the water, her surfing family history, and the ups and downs of the Championship Tour. Featuring brother Mason Ho, father Michael Ho, and surfers John John Florence and Stephanie Gilmore.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: The Backyard
programme.desc: At Pipeline there is flora, fauna, ocean and stone. Volcom Stone. At this point, the Volcom house is practically part of the reef. Between the team, the family, the legacy, the peanut gallery, the respect, the Pipe Pro and the barbecues, you’d be hard pressed not to notice Volcom on the North Shore.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Telo Menta Uber Jam
programme.desc: This film is what happens when you jam a bunch of rowdy surfers together for a two-week boat trip in the Mentawais. Perfect waves and incredible footage. Featuring the Volcom Surf team: Yago Dora, Ozzie Wright, Mitch Coleborn, Pat Schmidt, Charly Quivront, and Ryan Burch.

programme.title: Billabong Presents: The Cape
programme.desc: What happens when good winds, good weather, and a solid swell come together along one of the rawest stretches of coastline on the planet? You don't stop. Surfers Taj Burrow, Shaun Manners, Jaleesa Vincent, and Matt Bromley test their staying power on this Adventure Division strike mission.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Aliens Was Here
programme.desc: Five weeks in Bali with the Volcom Surf team. Featuring Ozzy Wrong, Noa Deane, Balaram Stack, Mitch Coleborn, Ryan Burch, Andrew Doheny, Yago Dora, Nate Tyler, Mauro Diaz, Pat Schmidt, Miguel Tudela, Leon Glatzer, Harry Timson, William Aliotti, Shun Murakami, Muklis Anwar, Mason Ho and more.

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: Neverland
programme.desc: Neverland is a state of mind, a mountain pushed up from the ground by imagination. Anyone can go but most people have trouble with the simple directions: Follow your dreams.

programme.title: Sparks
programme.desc: Take a pow trip around the world and into the mind of Wolle Nyvelt to find out why his passion for snowboarding runs so deep. From his legendary tenure as a rider to his work shaping pow surfers with Asmo, Wolle has dedicated his life to the culture of sliding sideways. "Sparks is the exploration into what makes snowboarding so fun and exciting to us all. It’s an interpretation of our lifestyle; the culture of building boards, riding mountains, and the adventure of choosing this path.” - Wolle Nyvelt

programme.title: Äsmosphere
programme.desc: Äsmosphere is the surf-influenced creation of Wolfgang Nyvelt showcasing his craftsmanship and appreciation for the glide and the turns we take on snow. After 16 years of filming legendary video parts, freeriding is now at the forefront of Wolle’s mind.

programme.title: Inaka
programme.desc: ‘Inaka’ is a short film about Iwanai, ‘the hidden beauty’ of Hokkaido. Snowboarders Wolfgang Nyvelt, Garrett Warnick and Bode Merrill drop everything and head to the North Island of Japan in search of good times and backcountry powder. Filmed by Billabong ambassador and filmmaker Chris Burkard.

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: Optimistic?
programme.desc: For those who live to snowboard, climate change can present an impossible challenge or become a catalyst for creativity. It all depends on how you look at it. In the movie Optimistic?, Absinthe Films follows 15 riders as they each explore the effects of global warming. Timely. Innovative. Positive.

programme.title: Hillside Project - Prototyping in Mayrhofen
programme.desc: This past year, Louif Paradis and Harrison Gordon visited Wolle’s hometown of Mayrhofen to better understand the complex prototyping process and to see where Wolle carved his teeth as a snowboarder and a shaper. Filmed by David Vladyka Riding: Wolle Nyvelt Harrison Gordon Louif Paradis Victor Daviet

programme.title: Hillside Project - Rizumu
programme.desc: An intergenerational exploration of Japan in search of rhythm, flow, and incredibly deep snow. Each year Wolle Nyvelt and a select crew of snowboarders set out to explore new terrain and test different shapes within the Hillside Project Series. After being closed to travel for the last couple of years, Japan was the obvious choice. Needless to say, the crew composed of Wolle, Takaharu Nakai, Louif Paradis and Luke Lund scored. Featuring: Wolle Nyvelt, Takaharu Nakai, Louif Paradis, Luke Lund Filmed by David Vladyka

programme.title: Hillside Project - Äsmo Factory
programme.desc: Making boards at the Äsmo factory! Featuring Josh Dirksen, Max Buri and Wolfgang Nyvelt

programme.title: MICRODOSE Josh Dirksen - Dose 03
programme.desc: Some of the greatest pro snowboarders to ever do it, claim Josh Dirksen as their favorite rider to watch. His Microdose story continues, taking on new dimensions with perspectives from more of his MtBachelor Bend Oregon crew: Kevin Jones, Todd Richards, Trevor Graves, Embry Rucker and Robbie Morrow

programme.title: MICRODOSE Josh Dirksen - Dose 04
programme.desc:
Growing up snowboarding the natural wind features of Mt. Bachelor played a big part in shaping Josh Dirksen's unique and seemingly effortless riding style. He seamlessly transferred his surf and skateboard influenced smoothness to a new audience, when he started filming with Kingpin Productions.
Featuring: Gerry Lopez, Travis Yamada, Kevin Jones, Trevor Graves, Rob Morrow, Allister Schultz, Chad Otterstrom, "Whitey" Rob McConnaughey

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Down For This
programme.desc: Down For This is a rollercoaster of adrenaline and heartfelt emotion in a 1-hour-25-minute slide of 30 years past to present. Featuring some of the most memorable Volcom skating surfing and snowboarding.

programme.title: SHE (Side Hits Euphoria) Chapter 1
programme.desc: In Chapter One of Side Hits Euphoria, snowboarders Oli Gittler and Arthur Longo showcase their favorite features to ride; random jumps and hits on the side of the piste. They spent their season capturing these little treasures hiding in plain sight.

programme.title: SHE (Side Hits Euphoria) Chapter 2
programme.desc: Chapter 2 of Side Hits Euphoria features resort riding, side hits, and random stuff on the slopes. In December 2018, the snowboarders Oli Gittler and Arthur Longo filmed everything they found during their travels to Mount Seymour in Canada, and in Laax and Arêches-Beaufort in Switzerland.

programme.title: SHE (Side Hits Euphoria) Chapter 3
programme.desc: Side Hits Euphoria is back! Chapter 3 features resort riding, side bonking, groomer gliding, and pure shredding. Filmed by the snowboarders Olivier Gittler and Arthur Longo in December of 2019, in and around Tignes, Val d’Isère, Avoriaz and Chamonix, France. Thanks for watching!

programme.title: Creedlecosm
programme.desc: Volcom presents CreedleCosm, a snowboarding cinematic masterpiece. Starring Mike Rav, Scott Blum, Desiree Melancon, Egan Wint, Seb Picaro, Arthur Longo, Torgeir Bergrem, Pat Moore, Bryan Iguchi, Jadyn Chomlack, Juliette Pelchat, Estelle Pensiero, Jamie Lynn, Alec Majerus and Simon Bannerot.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Crosspollution
programme.desc: High voltage shred flick from the Volcom Skateboarding and Snowboarding teams. Starring Benny Milam, Cody Warble, Reid Smith, Lenny Mazzotti, Jack Harold, Scott Blum, Christian Connors, CJ Collins, Axel Cruysberghs, Alec Majerus, Henry Gartland and Mike Ravelson. Edited by Seth Huot.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Inexact Odyssey
programme.desc: ‘Inexact Odyssey’ is a film about unexpected adventure and endless opportunity. From the winding canyons of Zion National Park to the high alpine passes of Arlberg, Austria, filmmaker Seth Huot uses his Super-8 camera to capture spontaneous travels and impromptu sessions with the Volcom Snow team.

programme.title: Pusher Bearings Presents: Tchin Tchin
programme.desc: In ‘Tchin Tchin’, the Pusher Bearings crew head to the South of France to do flip tricks and jump off cliffs. Featuring the skateboarding of Kilian Zehnder, Titi Gormit, Robin Fournier, Anto Lopez, Davide Holznecht, and Simon Perottet.

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: Neverland
programme.desc: Neverland is a state of mind, a mountain pushed up from the ground by imagination. Anyone can go but most people have trouble with the simple directions: Follow your dreams.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Escramble
programme.desc: In a time beyond and close to now... a vision was revealed. A vision of the very first dream of life. The dream of life before there was life. The dream that vapor dreams of becoming solid and falling to meet whatever will catch and hold it. Thus begins "ESCRAMBLE". Featuring Bjorn Leines, Terje Haakonsen, Mark Landvik, Wille Yli-Louma, Shaun White, Seth Huot, Gigi Rüf, Erik Leines, Bryan Iguchi, Chris Demolski and Jamie Lynn.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Back Yard Boogie
programme.desc: Terje Haakonsen rips his back yard on the snow-skate and Rip Zinger...well, yeah he gets creative too.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Torstein Horgmo - Dose 01
programme.desc: Bullying has long term and far too often, fatal effects. Torstein Horgmo is considered to be one of the top five snowboarders to ever strap in and snowboarding quite literally saved his life. Here is where his Microdose story begins.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Torstein Horgmo - Dose 02
programme.desc: Bullying has long term and far too often, fatal effects. Torstein Horgmo is considered to be one of the top five snowboarders to ever strap in and snowboarding quite literally saved his life. Here is where his Microdose story begins.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Torstein Horgmo - Dose 03
programme.desc: Bullying has long term and far too often, fatal effects. Torstein Horgmo is considered to be one of the top five snowboarders to ever strap in and snowboarding quite literally saved his life. Here is where his Microdose story begins.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Torstein Horgmo - Dose 04
programme.desc: Bullying has long term and far too often, fatal effects. Torstein Horgmo is considered to be one of the top five snowboarders to ever strap in and snowboarding quite literally saved his life. Here is where his Microdose story begins.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Torstein Horgmo - Dose 05
programme.desc: Bullying has long term and far too often, fatal effects. Torstein Horgmo is considered to be one of the top five snowboarders to ever strap in and snowboarding quite literally saved his life. Here is where his Microdose story begins.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Torstein Horgmo - Dose 06
programme.desc: Bullying has long term and far too often, fatal effects. Torstein Horgmo is considered to be one of the top five snowboarders to ever strap in and snowboarding quite literally saved his life. Here is where his Microdose story begins.

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: Eversince
programme.desc: Can you remember the moment you knew you were hooked on snowboarding? 'Eversince' is a film about the first time, and chasing the unforgettable feeling every time after. Featuring: Lucas Debari, Jason Robinson, Keegan Valaika, Lizard King, Manuel Diaz, Bode Merrill, Nicolas Müller, Fredi Kalbermatten, Cale Zima, Brandon Cocard.

programme.title: Mountain Minded - Episode 1
programme.desc: Your friends at Absinthe Films, along with Nils Mindnich, Pat Moore, Kimmy Fasani, Jeff Pensiero and others, remind you to prepare for the season with safe practices in mind.

programme.title: Mountain Minded - Episode 2
programme.desc: The fine folks at Absinthe Films, along with Nils Mindnich, Pat Moore, Kimmy Fasani, Jeff Pensiero and others, remind you to prepare for the season with safe practices in mind.

programme.title: Mountain Minded - Episode 3
programme.desc: The fine folks at Absinthe Films, along with Nils Mindnich, Pat Moore, Kimmy Fasani, Jeff Pensiero and others, remind you to prepare for the season with safe practices in mind.

programme.title: Mountain Minded - Episode 4
programme.desc: The fine folks at Absinthe Films, along with Nils Mindnich, Pat Moore, Kimmy Fasani, Jeff Pensiero and others, remind you to prepare for the season with safe practices in mind.

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: AfterForever
programme.desc: When resistance fades, growth begins. AfterForever is a meditation on change, exploring evolution in snowboarding and life, and asking what happens when one chapter ends and another begins.

programme.title: Wash'Dup
programme.desc: Based on a true story, this mockumentary film will follow a group of ex- snowboard filmmakers and ex-pro riders who never hung it up. Still in love with the sport and fueled by mid life crisis, these shred for lifers are extremely vulnerable to delusions of grandeur. But the dream is always “still alive” in their minds. In turn they ignore all the red flags and continue to do what seems completely irrational to everyone except for them. After a 16 year hiatus, they irresponsibly put their adult obligations behind, and join a pact to make just one last movie. But they are missing a solid presence of youth to make their movie marketable. As a remedy they end up filming with riders that span 2 generations. This unlikely alliance leads them to discover much more about snowboarding and themselves by living the snowboarding dream through an ageless lens. Filled with sketch comedy skits, this film expresses the nuanced story of a young sport reaching a level of maturity the current industry now begins to embrace. From the death of the snowboard shop, and extinction of film media, to the old pro struggling to find their way in life after the glory days are long gone, WashDup is a story that finally needs to be told.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Elena Hight - Dose 01
programme.desc: Elena Hight is one of the most accomplished women in snowboarding history. Interestingly, her passion for boardsports culture originated in her home state of Hawaii on the island of Kauai. This is where Elena’s Microdose series begins. Featuring Jamie Anderson, Papa Mike, Chris Owen, Louie Vito.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Elena Hight - Dose 02
programme.desc: From the moment she strapped into a snowboard, Elena Hight has been an innovative and visionary force in women’s snowboarding. In Episode 2 of her Microdose series, we take a look at two of Elena’s greatest achievements. Featuring Jamie Anderson, Scotty Lago and Louie Vito.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Elena Hight - Dose 03
programme.desc: At age 16, during the 2006 Torino Olympics, Elena Hight was the youngest American to compete in Women’s Halfpipe. In 2010, at the Vancouver Olympics, she sowed the seeds of change to come. In Episode 3 of Elena’s Microdose series we explore more. Featuring Selema Masekela, Papa Mike and Louie Vito.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Elena Hight - Dose 04
programme.desc: Failure in life can be our biggest teacher. In Episode 4 of her Microdose series, we learn how Elena Hight embraced failure on the global stage, embarked on transformative change, and unlocked her next level. Featuring Selema Masekela, Hana Beaman, Spencer O'Brien, Jamie Anderson, and Jeremy Jones.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Elena Hight - Dose 05
programme.desc: When Elena Hight made the surprising decision to set aside her Olympic routine to pursue backcountry riding, she astonished her peers and mentors. In Episode 5 of her Microdose series, we learn how and why Elena made the leap. Featuring Jeremy Jones, Hana Beaman, Todd Jones, and Jamie Anderson.

programme.title: Arc’teryx Presents: On The Verge
programme.desc: In the mountains behind the coastal town of Powell River, BC, rock climbers have spent decades quietly pioneering routes on some of the largest granite walls in Canada. As the landscape comes under threat of logging, the climbing community faces an uncertain future. Lives! Logs! Legacies!

programme.title: 12 Dogs Drive
programme.desc: Facing incredible physical and emotional challenges, a musher and his dog sled team travel from Churchill Manitoba, three thousand kilometres through the wilderness to their new home in Saint John, New Brunswick Canada.

programme.title: FLIPSIDE Dopamine Episodes 1 - 9
programme.desc: Flipside is the show that takes you behind the scenes with Absinthe Films during the making of our movies. Follow the life, times, and travels of the most progressive and entertaining riders in snowboarding.

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: Dopamine
programme.desc: Dopamine is a naturally occurring chemical produced by the human brain, which controls movement and reward. In the world of progressive snowboarding, the joy of physical movement and the reward of being outside are the two greatest factors motivating riders to evolve and innovate. The Absinthe Films documentary Dopamine captures professional snowboarders pushing boundaries and chasing storms across the Chilkats, Valhallas, Monashees, Dolomites, and Pyrenees mountains.

programme.title: Midlife Crisis Presents: Fast Forward
programme.desc: Midlife Crisis is back with Fast Forward. Featuring the age-defying shredders John Jackson, Blaise Rosenthal, Kevin Jones, Todd Richards, Chad Otterstrom, Daniel Franck, and more. We’re here for it, and so are you.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Kimmy Fasani - Dose 01
programme.desc: Kimmy Fasani is a world class athlete, a loving mother, a natural leader, and a true champion of women in professional snowboarding. In Episode 1 of her Microdose series, we learn where Fasani’s glorious story begins. Featuring Shannon Dunn, Donna Carpenter, Hana Beaman, Gabe Taylor and Ryan Runke.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Kimmy Fasani - Dose 02
programme.desc: In Episode 2 of her Microdose series, we learn how Kimmy Fasani stepped away from the contest scene and into backcountry snowboarding with help from shred legend Devun Walsh and innovator Iikka Backstrom. Featuring Chris Benchetler, Devun Walsh, Adam Moran, Bryan Knox and Peter Morning.

programme.title: MICRODOSE Kimmy Fasani - Dose 03
programme.desc: As a Burton athlete, Kimmy Fasani has long been a champion of change in women's snowboarding. Innovative products. Fair pay. Better contracts. Sick ripping. Watch and be uplifted. Featuring Hana Beaman, Pat Bridges, Danny Davis, Gabe Taylor, Kevin Pearce, Bryan Knox, Adam Moran and Peter Morning.

programme.title: Evo Explores: Kimmy Fasani
programme.desc: Over the course of her career, snowboarder Kimmy Fasani has won the coveted “Women’s Rider of The Year Award” from TransWorld Snowboarding Magazine, and the “Women’s Video Part of The Year Award” from Snowboarder Magazine. This fascinating documentary captures Fasani’s first time riding in Alaska.

programme.title: Evo Explores: Brandon Cocard
programme.desc: An early morning of magic in Haines, Alaska with the Absinthe Films crew. Featuring: Brandon Cocard Kimmy Fasani, Nicolas Müller

programme.title: Echo Chamber
programme.desc: In 2020, Brandon Cocard dropped “Echo Chamber,” featuring cameos from Miles Fallon, Kazu Kokubo, Taylor Elliott, Brendon Rego, Kevin Backstrom, Mike Rav, Kaede Yasunaga, Keisuke Yoshida and Chris Beresford. Filmed in Hokkaido, Japan and Salt Lake City, Utah by Sam Tuor. Music by Cocard and friends.

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: AfterForever
programme.desc: When resistance fades, growth begins. AfterForever is a meditation on change, exploring evolution in snowboarding and life, and asking what happens when one chapter ends and another begins.

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: Stay Tuned
programme.desc: ‘Stay Tuned’ is a snowboard film. It is also a film about the need to stay tuned mentally and physically with the natural world. Featuring Mikkel Bang, Nicolas Müller, John Jackson, Brandon Cocard, Ben Ferguson, Red Gerard, Severin Van Der Meer, Dylan Alito, Judd Henkes, and Hans Mindnich.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Yellow Flickers
programme.desc: Do the lines in the road countdown to a supposed arrival? Or are they added up within us, allowing us to grow?

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Relax If You Can
programme.desc: Terje Haakonsen and Leo Cittadella go snowskating at the vast Austrian ski resort of Ischgl. While enjoying a timeout along the Swiss-Austrian border, they discuss European cultural differences and similarities.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Winter Leisure
programme.desc: Legendary snowboarder Terje Haakonsen finds new joy in riding small parks and mellow terrain wherever he goes, explaining, “What I like about snowskates is that it makes small hills big again.” Join us for this fascinating look at snowskate subculture.

programme.title: Balance
programme.desc: Legendary professional snowboarder David Carrier-Porcheron reflects on Surf, Skate, and Snow culture, taking a closer look at what brings balance and happiness to people’s lives. Join us for this thoughtful and exhilarating ride with DCP.

programme.title: Perspektiv
programme.desc: David Carrier-Porcheron is a titan in the snowboarding community. When the COVID-19 pandemic hit, DCP and family were left stranded in Costa Rica. Perspektiv tells the story of his return to snow after 13 months. Watch as he rediscovers his love of snowboarding, and why he can’t live without it.

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: NowHere
programme.desc: A 2010 winter journey with riders facing harsh conditions and deeper questions. This Absinthe Films documentary explores perception, purpose, and the fine line between feeling lost and finding where you truly belong.

programme.title: Mission Antarctic
programme.desc: ‘Mission Antarctic’ is a snowboarding expedition to the world’s end. Xavier de le Rue and Lucas DeBari set out from the Falklands on a 20-meter sailboat, navigating the Drake Passage to explore the Antarctic Peninsula. Awarded ‘Best Freeride Movie’ at the 2013 International Freeride Film Festival.

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: Isle Of Snow
programme.desc: Join us as we explore the snowboard world through the perspectives of the people who live it and have made it their lives follow their passions.

programme.title: The ManBoys Presents: Business Casual
programme.desc: Business Casual follows the Burton Snowboards crew and the Manboys as they enjoy the best part of the season in the Whistler area while Rusty Ockenden learns to operate a camera. The ManBoys crew encourages anyone who wants to get into the backcountry to take a first aid & avalanche course with your whole crew. Be safe, have fun, learn from your mistakes - and learn from theirs. Featuring Jody Wachniak, Mark Sollors, Noah Cohen, Mikey Rencz, Matt Belzile, and Beau Bishop. Directed and edited by Rusty Ockenden

programme.title: The ManBoys Presents: Snowdance
programme.desc: Snowdance is a backcountry snowboarding film. Because even if you’ve never set foot in the backcountry, you can still be grateful that it’s there. Seven years and one pandemic since their fruition, The ManBoys roster still remains largely intact with Chris Rasman, Rusty Ockenden, Matt Belzile, Jody Wachniak, Beau Bishop & Eric Jackson. Snowdance was filmed by Ben Webb, Connor Winton, Dave Craig, and Ryan Kenny.

programme.title: The Manboys Movie
programme.desc: The boys are back with new friends and a brand new snowboard film. The Manboys Movie will definitely top your expectations. Featuring bangers from Chris Rasman, Rusty Ockenden, Craig McMorris, Jody Wachniak, Matt Belzile, Anto Chamberland, and Mark Sollors.

programme.title: Air Time Podcast - Devun Walsh
programme.desc: Devun Walsh aka the GOAT. If only you could put into words the impact Devun has had on snowboarding. From his signature style, timeless tricks, mentorship, films, companies, attitude and his overall vision for our culture… and of course his ability to seek out and find new zones and features that till this day are the gold standard of professional backcountry riding. Truly one of the greats. Thanks for coming on boss. Enjoy!

programme.title: La Zone
programme.desc:
In the early 2000's, snowboard filmer David 'Vlad' Vladyka and a handful of riders discovered an off-the-radar area on the French-Swiss border that held massive potential for shooting freestyle snowboarding. The mountain pass featured rolling terrain punctuated by steep roll overs that are perfect for building jumps. The area was Le Col de Cou, and though it had a name, the riders called it 'La Zone', a purposefully vague nickname that would help them keep the area a secret.
Over the next decade, La Zone would become one of the most productive and standard setting locations for filming freestyle snowboarding in all of Europe. Shots from La Zone were featured in several Absinthe films, and many others.
Now 20 years later, Jones team rider Mat Schaer and Vlad still return to La Zone to film from time to time, but the pristine slopes they enjoyed in the past are much harder to find as Le Col de Cou has become a popular ski touring destination.
Featuring new and historic footage from La Zone, this new short film directed by Julien Rosens, and produced by Absinthe Films, highlights the history, beauty and inevitable evolution of this legendary shred spot.
Credits LA ZONE, a movie directed by Julien Roserens Produced by Absinthe Films Supported by Jonessnowboards, Region Dents du Midi, Doodah store Edited by Jules Guarneri Soundmix by Stephane Chapelle Graphics by René Zumstein Photo by Michael Cordey Music : Tugrul by Ochre, Rhea by Yehezkel Raz, Where It Beginns It Ends by Be Still The Earth, Strange Life de YGGL, Let Us Get Out by Redder

programme.title: FLIPSIDE Futureproof
programme.desc: In shred world, Absinthe Films’ “Futureproof” is widely regarded as a stone cold classic. In this FLIPSIDE we follow the Absinthe Films crew through the making of the feature film "Futureproof".

programme.title: Absinthe Films Presents: Futureproof
programme.desc: In shred world, Absinthe Films’ "Futureproof" is widely regarded as a stone cold classic. This movie showcases iconic performances from many of the best riders to ever do it, including Romain De Marchi, JP Solberg, Trevor Andrew Wolfgang Nyvelt and Gigi Rüf.

programme.title: Doodah Presents: Spacé - Glacier

All his life, the snowboarder Frederik Kalbermatten has lived in close proximity to the glaciers of the Swiss Alps. To this day, he constantly follows their flow and rides the eternal ice unlike anyone on earth.

programme.title: Doodah Presents: Spacé - Woods
programme.desc: The Larch Forests are the highest in the Swiss Alps. The old trees hold back snow, reduce avalanche danger, and offer contrast during low visibility conditions. Snowboarder Frederik Kalbermatten shows you how to navigate steep pillow lines and narrow gullies in this uniquely challenging terrain.

programme.title: Volcom Presents: Escramble

Featuring Bjorn Leines, Terje Haakonsen, Mark Landvik, Wille Yli-Louma, Shaun White, Seth Huot, Gigi Rüf, Erik Leines, Bryan Iguchi, Chris Demolski and Jamie Lynn.

programme.title: Longines Global Champions Tour - Episode 8 - Stockholm
programme.desc: The Swedish capital of Stockholm is the host of the eighth leg of the Longines Global Champions Tour 2022: the international circuit that challenges top-riders from around the world in individual show jumping. As one of the hardest jump offs this season, who will make it to the top in Sweden? Watch the highlights of the Longines Global Champions Tour Stockholm Grand Prix!

programme.title: Sunshine Tour - Week 5
programme.desc: The fifth week of the Sunshine Tour 2020 is running short due to the COVID-19 pandemic, but the exciting past weeks of the competition are not over until the Suzuki Grand Prix is disputed. In the last day of the XXVI Sunshine Tour, both riders and horses enjoyed a wonderful competition, and the best riders have made it to the jumpoff. Enjoy the best moments of the fifth week of the Sunshine Tour, on HorseTV.

programme.title: Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup - Mexico - HL
FEI Rides Magazine - Episode 4: Horsewomen
programme.desc: This week Ride celebrates three extraordinary horsewomen and the captivating connection they have with their equine friends. We showcase exhebition work from American dressage star Sabine Schut-Kery, experience life through a lens with Poland’s fine art horse photographer Katarzyna Okrzesik-Mikolajek, and witness the holistic approach to healing in South West England with renowned trainer Connie Cox.

programme.title: FEI Rides Magazine - Episode 5: Heroes & Healers
programme.desc: This week Ride exercises military precision with the mounts of the Household Cavalry at the British Army’s London Barracks, and sees second chances given to troubled residents at Achterhoek horse shelter in the Netherlands. We’re in the back seat with Polish driving expert Piotr Mazurek and catch up with this year’s Longines FEI Rising Star Award winner, Germany’s Greta Busacker.

programme.title: Polo Rider Cup Competition - Deauville International Polo Club vs Las Brisas Polo Club Of Chicago
programme.desc: This time, Deauville International Polo Club will be up against Las Brisas Polo Club of Chicago in order to keep advancing at the 2021 Polo Rider Cup celebrated in Chantilly. programme.title: The Polo Show - Episode 3
programme.desc: Welcome to episode 3 of The Polo Show. This time we travel to the home of polo for a special look at the iconic English season. programme.title: The Polo Show - Episode 4

programme.desc: Get ready for a ride with us in this new episode of Horse Academy Pro! programme.title: Banorte Trophy - Highlights
programme.desc: The two-round challenge for the Banorte Trophy has 40 riders competing in this CSI5* test of the LGCT Mexico.
